title: Add Shift-assisted opposite-edge resizing to Grab And Move

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep the opposite-corner test start inside the corner region

**Severity:** `medium`

Choose the opposite-corner drag start relative to the measured fixture size. The fixture scales with the work area, so for bounds of 266×186 the fixed (60,60) offset is nearer `Left` than `TopLeft`. The new test then resizes the opposite `Right` edge but expects both width and height to shrink. Keeping the start inside the upper-left quarter makes this test exercise `BottomRight` consistently.

```suggestion
            ? new Point(before.Left + (before.Width / 8), before.Top + (before.Height / 8))
```
proposed_comments.title: Keep opposite-corner test starts in the corner region

confidence.rationale: Exact upstream point expression selects Left for the small fixture; the compiled one-line literal selects TopLeft, and both complete managed test-project builds pass.
